name: Lossy Quantization for Coarsened Patches
definition: Lossy compression for coarsened patches in the bintree hierarchy. Quantization error q is proportional to coarsening error c: q = qc, where q is a fixed constant usually < 1. A single unified error is recomputed and nested for each patch. Quantization levels are restricted to power-of-two multiples of vertical resolution ∆z for efficient bit-shift implementation. Shift k is calculated as: k = ceil(log2(ε_q / ∆z)) + 1 if ε_q ≥ ∆z, else 0. All finest level vertices have zero shift. Vertices classified as boundary (corners C, legs L, hypotenuse H) and interior I. Corners stored at full precision. Quantization of original height values (not residuals) ensures adjacent patches agree on shared boundaries.
